info.title: Chunkyard API
info.description: Single-owner Docker Minecraft manager. Public API reference; protected controls accept browser sessions or owner bearer API keys. Browser mutations require matching Origin/Referer and X-MCM-CSRF: 1. Valid bearer requests do not need browser CSRF headers; supplied Origin and Host remain validated. Console and shared Docker metrics use same-origin WebSockets.

put.description: Save the recovery policy. Auto-start runs on manager startup; bounded crash recovery honors manual stop/kill and clean exits. Five minutes of stable container uptime resets the crash retry budget.

default.description: Authenticated owner problem response

put.description: Stopped-only full verified S3 backups at fixed intervals. Online instances are skipped, never stopped automatically. Retention is optional and prunes only scheduler-created backups after a new verified backup; manual and pinned archives are protected. Changing keepLast to a number requires confirmRetentionDeletion.

default.description: Authenticated owner problem response

put.description: Enable/disable about one-minute snapshots for running containers even with no browser open. Existing history expires after seven days.

default.description: Authenticated owner problem response

get.description: Up to 720 aggregate points from bounded one-minute snapshots; averages cover observed samples, not continuous CPU usage. Missing samples remain missing. Seven-day retention and a manager-wide 100000-row cap.

default.description: Authenticated owner problem response

get.summary: Read saved properties and applied revision
get.description: Imports an existing file on first read. Returns desired content, not necessarily the running JVM's file. Legacy/external starts have appliedVersion=null until a managed start. Minecraft-generated defaults are recorded when observed without discarding pending owner edits.

put.summary: Save a revision while running or stopped
put.description: Requires same-origin Origin/Referer. Persists desired configuration/history separately; does not restart or modify the active instance file. Start/restart applies it atomically before Docker starts. Identical text creates no revision. Stale etag returns409 properties.conflict.

post.summary: Restore a revision as a new desired version
post.description: Requires same-origin Origin/Referer. Does not restart or rewrite history. Etag must match the current desired revision.

get.description: Same-origin browser WebSocket with normal cookie authentication. Matching Origin required even with auth disabled; no CSRF header for this read-only GET. Snapshot frame resets the client, followed by ordered line frames from one Docker follow request including its last200 records. Lines cap at8192 UTF-8 bytes; up to256 lines per Docker frame are retained. Stopped instances return409. Maximum16 connections with bounded buffers, heartbeat/disconnect handling and session revalidation every5s. Commands remain on the commands POST route.

Empty path lists root. At most 5000 entries, directories first. Protected .chunkyard-* paths are hidden; links are listed without traversal. canWrite is false for running instances or an unavailable Docker engine.

get.summary: Read UTF-8 text up to 1 MiB

put.summary: Atomically save text on a stopped instance
put.description: Send the etag from the previous read; null/omitted is create-only. Stale saves return 409 files.conflict. NUL/binary text is rejected. Root eula.txt is read-only. Requires a same-origin Origin/Referer and X-MCM-CSRF: 1.

content.description: UTF-8 bytes at most 1 MiB; JSON envelope at most 8 MiB.

get.summary: Stream one regular file as an attachment
get.description: Works while running. No directory ZIP or Range support. Maximum four concurrent downloads; 429 files.busy if all slots are occupied.

post.summary: Stream an upload into a stopped instance
post.description: Raw body, not multipart/base64. Up to 128 MiB, four concurrent uploads, 60-second idle timeout. Atomic publication; existing file remains intact on interrupted/oversized uploads. Existing destinations require explicit overwrite=true. Requires same-origin Origin/Referer.

post.summary: Create a directory on a stopped instance
post.description: Parent must exist. Requires same-origin Origin/Referer.

post.summary: Move or rename a stopped instance's file/directory
post.description: No overwrite or symbolic links. Destination parent must exist. Requires same-origin Origin/Referer.

post.summary: Copy a stopped instance's file/directory
post.description: No overwrite or symbolic links. Bounded to 512 MiB, 5000 entries and 32 levels. Failed directory copies remove their newly created destination. Requires same-origin Origin/Referer.

post.summary: Permanently delete a stopped instance's file/directory
post.description: Root, EULA and protected artifacts cannot be removed. Nonempty directories require recursive=true. Requires same-origin Origin/Referer.

delete.description: Queues server.delete. Requires a stopped instance and excludes concurrent lifecycle/install work. Removes only the owned Docker container and instance record. Files are retained by default; deleteFiles=true also deletes the managed directory including worlds. Success job.result.deleted contains id, filesDeleted and retainedDirectory (null when no files remain). Interrupted cleanup can be retried on the same ID. Never force-stops a game server.

get.description: Same-origin authenticated WebSocket. One shared sequential Docker one-shot sampler per container. The fastest active viewer controls collection cadence (intervalMs: 100–60000); slow Docker responses reduce the actual rate without creating a backlog. Frames: {type:sample,sample:ServerMetrics}, error, end. Latest-value backpressure and per-viewer delivery limits. Maximum 16 watched servers and 32 sockets. Credentials rechecked every 5 seconds.

post.description: Stateless MCP Streamable HTTP JSON responses. API bearer key required even in auth-disabled mode. Accept must include application/json and text/event-stream. Supports initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call. No OAuth connector flow or standalone SSE stream.

FilePath.name: path
FilePath.description: Instance-relative POSIX path. Empty only for listing root; no dot segments, backslashes, device names, or .chunkyard-* components.

RequiredFilePath.name: path
RequiredFilePath.description: Instance-relative POSIX path; no dot segments, backslashes, device names, or .chunkyard-* components.

FileCsrf.name: X-MCM-CSRF
FileCsrf.description: Required for browser session/trusted-mode mutations; not needed for valid bearer-key requests. Supplied Origin/Host are always validated.

PropertiesProblem.description: properties.conflict409; properties.not_found404; properties.invalid422; properties.too_large413; properties.storage500. Existing server.busy and files.* errors may also appear.

FileProblem.description: Problem response: path_invalid 422; symlink/protected 403; not_found 404; exists/conflict/not_empty/server_running 409; too_large 413; binary 415; busy 429; io 500. File codes use files. prefix. Lifecycle conflicts use server.busy 409. Authentication/origin protections also apply.

IntegrationProblem.description: Authentication, validation, capacity or internal failure; no credentials are returned.

cookieAuth.name: mcm_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie issued by setup or login. Required by protected endpoints unless authentication is disabled by configuration.

bearerAuth.description: Owner API key shown once at creation. Never send in query strings.

connectAddress.description: Suggested connection address; external routing/firewall reachability is not established by the probe.

intentAt.description: Internal nanosecond intent revision; not a display timestamp.

nextRetryAt.description: Unix seconds; lastHistoryAt is the last collection attempt.

stableSince.description: Unix seconds; lastHistoryAt is the last collection attempt.

nextBackupAt.description: Unix seconds; lastHistoryAt is the last collection attempt.

lastBackupAt.description: Unix seconds; lastHistoryAt is the last collection attempt.

lastHistoryAt.description: Unix seconds; lastHistoryAt is the last collection attempt.

appliedVersion.description: Manager-tracked applied revision, or null when unknown.

autoJava.description: Manager selects the matching Docker JVM image when no dockerImage was supplied for a managed install.

publishIp.description: Optional instance bind-address override; null uses the manager default.

archive.description: Null while local. Archived records stay in the inventory; local operations require restoration.

jar.description: Relative .jar path confined to this server directory.

port.description: Omit/null to atomically choose the first unassigned managed port from 25565. Explicit ports may be shared by stopped instances; only one instance per port may run at a time. Host services outside this manager can still occupy the port.

CreateServer.description: Creates a stopped Docker server record and initial files. Omit software for a manual JAR server. Managed software must be installed with POST /api/v1/servers/{id}/install. Java image is selected during installation unless dockerImage was explicitly provided. No download, EULA acceptance or game start occurs as a side effect of creation.

line.description: One command, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. CR, LF and NUL are rejected.

anyOf.description: Percent of one logical core; may exceed 100. Unknown when delta counters are missing or reset.

ServerMetrics.description: On-demand Docker snapshot. Stopped or paused containers return status and null measurements. Working-set memory subtracts inactive file cache; it is not JVM heap. Network and block I/O are cumulative counters, not rates or filesystem size. No TPS, player count, or game readiness claim.

setupToken.description: Bootstrap token read from the private local setup-token file.

markdown.description: The generated project changelog bundled with this build; no per-user or server history.

anyOf.description: Optional stable build number. Omission resolves latest stable once during installation.

fileId.description: Client release with a linked serverPackFileId.

Software.description: Managed Vanilla/Paper releases or a CurseForge modpack client release. Standalone Forge/Fabric selections are not offered yet.

checksum.description: Verified artifact checksum: published SHA-1 for Vanilla, SHA-256 for Paper, or calculated SHA-256 of the published/checksum-verified CurseForge server ZIP.

path.description: Instance-relative launch file; no absolute or dot paths.

logoUrl.description: Same-origin normalized logo route, or null. Never a remote CDN URL.

HostCapacity.description: Docker engine-visible totals, not free memory or the manager container limits. Nested engine constraints may be narrower.

url.description: Same-origin image URL with content version

WorkProgress.description: Observed stage progress; totals are null when unknown. Compression counts output bytes; upload counts bytes read into HTTP, followed by separate S3 verification.
